reason: A local recipe orchestration plugin that helps users discover, expand, and combine ordered bundles of plugins into environment setup command sequences.

summaries.zh: 通过列出、搜索、展开和组合本地配方，帮助用户按场景整理插件环境及其安装顺序。
summaries.en: Helps users discover, expand, and combine local plugin recipes into ordered environment setup command sequences.

capabilities: Lists and searches local plugin recipes
Expands recipes into ordered plugin lists and installation command sequences
Composes multiple recipes with deduplication and preserved order
